title_ar: الشيخ الددو يشارك في اجتماع المكتب التنفيذي للاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين في الدوحة
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the Meeting of the Executive Bureau of the International Union of Muslim Scholars in Doha
body_ar: شارك الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في اجتماع المكتب التنفيذي لاتحاد علماء المسلمين المنعقد في الدوحة يوم الخميس الموافق ل 28/04/2011. كما شارك في اليوم نفسه في اجتماع رؤساء لجان الاتحاد بوصفه رئيس لجنة العضوية فيه. وفي السياق ذاته شارك الشيخ الددو في ملتقى العلماء والمفكرين الصوماليين الذي أشرف الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين على تنظيمه في مقره بالدوحة يوم الجمعة الموافق ل 29/04/2011، وألقى محاضرة في نفس الملتقى بعنوان: " التطرف "، ويستمر هذا الملتقى إلى غاية يوم الأحد الموالي. ولمتابعة محاضرة الشيخ في ملتقى العلماء والمفكرين الصوماليين إضغط هنا.
body_en:
Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, took part in the meeting of the executive bureau of the Union of Muslim Scholars held in Doha on Thursday 28/04/2011. On the same day he also took part in the meeting of the heads of the Union's committees, in his capacity as head of its membership committee.

In the same connection, Sheikh al-Dedew took part in the forum of Somali scholars and thinkers, whose organisation the International Union of Muslim Scholars oversaw at its headquarters in Doha on Friday 29/04/2011, and delivered a lecture at that same forum entitled "Extremism". This forum continues until the following Sunday.

flags.arabic: وألقى محاضرة في نفس الملتقى بعنوان: " التطرف "
flags.context: the only substantive item in the notice
options: render the title alone, since the record contains nothing of the lecture
flags.note: The record gives the title of a lecture on extremism, delivered to a forum of Somali scholars in Doha in April 2011, and not one word of its content. The subject and the audience make this a lecture whose substance would matter a great deal, and its absence should be visible on the page: nothing whatever can be inferred from this record about what the Sheikh said. The English adds no characterisation. If a recording exists it is in the site's media system and is out of scope for text translation.

flags.arabic: اجتماع المكتب التنفيذي لاتحاد علماء المسلمين ... الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين
flags.context: the name of the organisation, given in two forms within the record
options: render each occurrence as the source has it and flag the inconsistency
harmonise to the full name throughout
flags.note: The title and the second paragraph give the full name, 'the International Union of Muslim Scholars'; the first sentence drops 'العالمي' and gives 'the Union of Muslim Scholars'. Both are the same body. Each occurrence is rendered as served rather than harmonised, and the organisation's own English name should be used throughout once confirmed by the Sheikh's office.

translator_notes: A short site news notice listing attendance at three meetings and one lecture, not a text by the Sheikh, and containing no content from any of them.
Dates are given in the source in numeric form and are kept as served.

The page ends with a navigation line inviting the reader to click through to the recording in the site's separate media system; it is a site affordance rather than content and is not part of body_ar or body_en.
